purpose: Teach: 文中/合弁/集大成/係長/特設/別冊/交替/年率

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約書の文中の表現を見直せ
lines.en: Review the language in our contract documents.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. No softening. Direct eye contact. Expects immediate acknowledgment and action. Measured pace—each clause lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の合弁会社の設立準備を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the setup for our overseas joint venture.
lines.style: Calm, professional confirmation. Slight lean forward—showing engagement. Steady tone, no hesitation. Reports competence without seeking praise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創立記念事業を集大成として実施しろ
lines.en: Make our anniversary event the culmination of everything we've built.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Weight on 「集大成」. Not asking—directing with quiet authority. A moment longer than comfortable, showing he expects them to understand the significance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の係長会議の議事録を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the minutes from the sales section meeting.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient. No elaboration. Brief pause before speaking shows he's been ready. Tone: matter-of-fact delivery of a completed task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 展示会の特設ブースを華やかにしろ
lines.en: Make the special exhibition booth striking and memorable.
lines.style: Sharp, visual instruction. Slight emphasis forward—he can picture it. Not a question, a mandate. Pace quickens slightly—momentum building toward execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内報の別冊で新商品を紹介します
lines.en: Yes. We'll introduce the new products in a special supplement to the company newsletter.
lines.style: Thoughtful, planned. Shows he's considered the channel. Steady rhythm. Slight warmth—this is a good solution and he knows it. Confident without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、シフト交替の体制を見直せ
lines.style: Clipped, direct. No preamble. The voice of someone used to being heard. Brief silence after—waiting for absorption before moving on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。借入金の年率を低く抑えました
lines.en: Yes. We've managed to keep the interest rate on the loan lower than expected.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction underneath. Slight uptick in tone—this one was won. Not triumphant, just honest: this matters. Finality in the trailing period.
